About this portfolio

Organised by week, with each reflection followed by the evidence behind it.

Team Speed built Lift Right for a warehouse safety brief. Workers walk through a first-person warehouse, make safe-lifting decisions at six checkpoints, and are scored in real time. Supervisors get a dashboard of who has trained and how well.

My job was everything behind the screen: the data, the scoring, the accounts and the admin tools. This page collects what I did each week, what I learned, and how the team worked.

My contribution

Each piece depended on the one before it, so each had to land on time for the team to keep moving.

Week 3

Checkpoint data

Six handling stages and state tracking.

Week 4

Scoring engine

Points for correct answers, a 15-point penalty, live HUD total.

Week 5

Login and stats

Accounts, attempts, time and best score per worker.

Week 6

Admin Command Center

Supervisor view with one-click CSV export.

Also: initial Three.js scene scaffold (Week 2), bug fixing (Week 7), final QA pass and live demo (Week 8).
